EASTERN COUNTIES POLICE ALLIANCE
DRAFT FRAMEWORK SPECIFICATION: AUTOMATED DRONE DOCKS (UP TO 300 UNITS)
Status: DRAFT v0.7. Not for circulation outside the spec team. Locks on day 20.

1. Scope
1.1 A framework under which any member force may call off docks, software and support.
1.2 Indicative volume: up to 300 docks over four years. No volume is guaranteed.
1.3 Each force places its own call-off and funds it from its own budget.

2. Evaluation
2.1 Price (licence and hardware): 25%
2.2 Cost per flight and operating model: 40%
    Comparator: the current helicopter air support contract.
    Bidders should show cost per flight and how docks would be operated and staffed.
2.3 Technical capability: 20%
2.4 Data protection and security: 15%

3. Operating model
3.1 [TBC] Who operates docks: force officers, a central alliance unit, or the supplier.
3.2 [TBC] Minimum staffing per dock and shift cover.

4. Data protection
4.1 Each force must complete a data protection impact assessment before live use.
4.2 Suppliers must provide data flows, retention periods, storage location and access controls.

5. Timetable
5.1 Supplier briefing window opens: day 8.
5.2 Written clarification questions: accepted during the briefing window.
5.3 Specification lock: day 20.

Comments (internal):
- HD: 3.1 and 3.2 still open. Nobody has costed the operating model.
- HD: 2.2 weights may move once finance partners respond.
